title: Eleven Tonnes of a Town
subtitle: 循环利用 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 循环利用（环境保护·循环利用与节约）
meta: 主题语境：循环利用（环境保护·循环利用与节约）　|　核心词汇：paper　|　正文 357 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 paper 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: My uncle ran the smallest ① paper mill in the county — two sheds and a machine older than he was — and he could tell you what a week of a town looked like by what came in on Monday. Mostly office ② paper, printed on one side and thrown out by people who had been told not to. He said the difficulty with paper is that nobody believes it is anything: a sheet of ③ paper is what you wrap a thing in and then forget, which is why it comes back in such quantities.

The mill had one customer, a factory making ④ paper bags, and one enemy, a man at the council who wanted everything on a screen. On ⑤ paper the man was right: no trees, no lorries, no water, and a figure in a report that fell every year. In the sheds it looked different. What came in was never only paper; it was envelopes with ⑥ papers still inside them, and, once, a folder marked 1974.

My uncle kept a drawer for whatever should not have been thrown away: letters, photographs, a ⑦ paper on the water beetles of the river, written by a man who had since died, and a local ⑧ newspaper from the week the river was declared clean. He said the beetle paper belonged in a library rather than a pulper, and he wrote to the library twice about it.

They replied ⑨ on paper both times, which my uncle took to be the joke. The mill closed in 2021 and the machine went for scrap. The sheds are now where people leave what they cannot bring themselves to throw out, which is a slower kind of recycling.

Exam ⑩ paper with names still on it is the commonest thing left in the sheds, and I think the names are the reason: nobody wants to be the one who threw them away. I kept one sheet of paper myself, the title page of the beetle paper, on the back of which my uncle had written in pencil the weight of a year of a town: eleven tonnes, most of it paper, none of it saying so.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n.[U] 纸；纸张（物质名词）
C. n.[C] 论文；学术文章（a paper on ...）
D. n.[C] 试卷；考卷（exam paper）
E. n.[pl.] 文件；证件；资料（papers）
F. 固定搭配：on paper 写在纸上；理论上；名义上
G. adj. 纸做的；纸质的；造纸的（paper bag / paper mill）
H. n.[C] 一张纸（a sheet / piece of paper）

items.q: the smallest paper mill in the county
a sheet of paper is what you wrap a thing in
On paper the man was right
envelopes with papers still inside them
a paper on the water beetles of the river
a local newspaper from the week
They replied on paper both times
Exam paper with names still on it

answers.why: paper mill 意为“造纸厂”，paper 作定语，意为“纸的、造纸的”。
office paper 指“办公用纸张”，paper 为不可数的物质名词。
a sheet of paper 意为“一张纸”，此处强调纸的“张”这个计量单位。
paper bags 意为“纸袋”，paper 作形容词，意为“纸制的”。
on paper 意为“理论上、从纸面数据看”，说按报告数字那个人是对的。
papers 复数意为“文件、证件、资料”，指信封里还留着的文件。
a paper on ... 意为“一篇关于……的论文”，此处是河中水甲虫的研究文章。
newspaper 意为“报纸”，此处是河水宣布变清那一周的当地报纸。
replied on paper 意为“用纸（写信）回复”，on paper 取“以书面形式”义。
exam paper 意为“试卷”，说写着名字的试卷是棚屋里最常见的东西。

我自己留下了一张纸，是那篇水甲虫论文的书名页。（a sheet of paper）

What came in on Monday was mostly office paper, printed on one side.
On paper the man was right.

answers: My uncle ran the smallest paper mill in the county, two sheds and a machine older than he was.
